settings.content: Shows inside the Variant picker when its style is Offer cards. Price, strike-through and savings come from the variant this card selects.

settings.label: Option value position
settings.info: Which value of the card option this card sells: 1 is the first value. On a product with one option this is the variant's position. 0 follows the order of these blocks.

settings.label: Label
settings.info: Leave blank to show the option value, for example 2 Pack. Do not type prices or savings here; the card computes them.

settings.label: Caption
settings.info: Describe what this option includes. Do not type prices, savings or 'was' amounts here; the card computes them from the variant's price and compare-at price.

settings.label: Badge
settings.info: For example Most popular. It shows only when the box below is ticked.

settings.label: Badge is backed by sales data
settings.info: Only tick if sales data supports this badge. Shoppers never see it otherwise.

settings.label: Benefit line
settings.info: Only promise what this option really includes, for example a shipping rate or a discount you have set up in Shopify.

settings.label: Show image
settings.info: Uses the image assigned to the card's variant, when the picker's card image is set to Variant image.
